from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol(); zr=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(40))
for k in range(4):
 ids=[]
 for i in range(7):
  a=Chem.Atom(6); a.SetNoImplicit(False); ids.append(rw.AddAtom(a))
 for i,j in [(0,2),(2,3),(3,1),(0,4),(4,5),(5,1),(0,6),(6,1)]: rw.AddBond(ids[i],ids[j],Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
 rw.AddBond(zr,ids[0],Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print(m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=42
print('embed',AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params))
print('uff',AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m))
if AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m): print(AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000))
AllChem.MolToMolFile(m,'/tmp/t.mol')
PY
